builds.title: Kiln road escort, Fighter 1
traits: Scale mail +4, heavy wooden shield +2, Dex +1. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 16. BAB +1, grapple +3. Fort +5, Ref +1, Will +0. Add +2 to saves against spells and spell-like abilities.
Fire resistance 5. Against dragons, AC 21 or touch AC 15 while eligible for Dexterity to AC. Grounded Stability gives +4 to checks resisting a trip or bull rush.
Combat Expertise and Improved Trip. Stonecunning adds +2 to checks involving unusual stonework. She can sense approximate depth underground and make the special Search check for stonework traps.
actions: Battleaxe +3 melee, 1d8+2 slashing, ×3. Add +1 to the attack roll against orcs or goblinoids.

With the axe dropped or stowed, trip at +3 melee touch, then make an opposed Strength check at +6. Improved Trip prevents the opening attack of opportunity and permits an immediate melee follow-up on success. With her axe out of hand, the follow-up can be an unarmed strike at +3 for 1d3+2 nonlethal, which provokes normally. A failed check may allow a counter-trip.
Combat Expertise shifts 1 point from melee attack rolls to dodge AC until her next action while she uses a melee attack action or full attack.
builds.tactics: Bera holds the narrow side of the kiln road, keeps her shield up, and tries a trip if someone rushes past her.

builds.title: Copper hill tracker, Ranger 1
traits: Leather armor +2, Dex +3, Small +1. Touch AC 14, flat-footed AC 13. BAB +1, grapple −3. Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +1. Dodge AC +4 against giants while eligible for Dexterity to AC.

Favored enemy Magical Beast gives +2 on weapon damage and on Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, and Survival checks involving those creatures. Bonuses to Climb and Survival from Hunter’s Insight are already included.
Track and Point Blank Shot. Wild Empathy +1 with animals or −3 with eligible magical beasts.
actions: Small shortbow +5 ranged, 1d4 piercing, ×3, range increment 60 ft. Point Blank Shot adds +1 attack and +1 damage within 30 ft.
Add +1 racial on weapon attacks against kobolds or goblinoids. Add +2 weapon damage against magical beasts.
Once each per day at caster level 1, use dancing lights, ghost sound (Will DC 10 to disbelieve), prestidigitation, or speak with animals for one minute with a burrowing mammal only.
builds.tactics: Idrin checks for tracks and asks a burrowing animal where an unfamiliar scent went. He stays at bow range in a fight.

builds.title: Caravan scout and field medic, Rogue 1
traits: Leather armor +2, Dex +3, Small +1. Touch AC 14, flat-footed AC 13. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fort +2, Ref +6, Will +2 include the halfling bonus. Add +2 morale against fear. Improved Initiative adds +4.

Sneak Attack adds 1d6 when an enemy is denied Dexterity to AC or is flanked in melee. Ranged Sneak Attack requires a target within 30 ft. Trapfinding allows Search for traps over DC 20 and Disable Device against magic traps. She carries ordinary thieves’ tools.
actions: Small dagger +1 melee or +5 thrown, 1d3 piercing or slashing in melee, piercing when thrown, 19–20/×2. Range increment 10 ft.
Touch of Luck once per day, immediate action before the roll. She or an ally within 30 ft. gets +2 luck on that saving throw.
First aid as a standard action. Heal +5 against DC 15 to stabilize a dying creature.
builds.tactics: Janna scouts ahead and saves her luck for an ally in danger. She looks for a safe flank or throws a dagger from cover.

builds.title: Night pass guard, Fighter 1
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. Light sensitivity causes dazzled in bright sunlight or a daylight spell.
traits: Scale mail +4, Dex +1. Touch AC 11, flat-footed AC 14. BAB +1, grapple +5. Fort +4, Ref +1, Will +0.
Cold resistance 10, fire vulnerability. Weapon Focus (spear), Power Attack, and racial Endurance. Dazzled gives −1 to attacks and to Search and Spot checks.
actions: Spear +6 melee, 1d8+6 piercing, ×3. Power Attack for 1 changes that to +5 melee and 1d8+8.
Spear +3 thrown, 1d8+4 piercing, ×3, range increment 20 ft.
Ready a planted spear against a charge for double damage on a hit against the charging creature.
builds.tactics: Hurg works nights to avoid the glare. He braces at the narrowest point and withdraws if the way fills with fire.

builds.title: Winter route ranger, Ranger 3
traits: Leather armor +2, Dex +3. Touch AC 13, flat-footed AC 12. BAB +3, grapple +6. Fort +5, Ref +6, Will +2. First hit die is 8 and later rolls are 4 each, before Constitution.

Cold resistance 10, fire vulnerability. Track, archery combat style, Point Blank Shot, Improved Initiative, and racial Endurance. Ranger 3 would grant Endurance again, so she takes Precise Shot and meets its prerequisite through Point Blank Shot.
Favored enemy Animal gives +2 on applicable Bluff, Listen, Sense Motive, Spot, Survival, and weapon damage. Wild Empathy +2 with animals, −2 with eligible magical beasts.
actions: Shortbow +6 ranged, 1d6 piercing, ×3, range increment 60 ft. Point Blank Shot adds +1 attack and +1 damage within 30 ft. Precise Shot removes the usual −4 for shooting a foe in melee.
Rapid Shot with light armor as a full attack, two shortbow attacks at +4 each before Point Blank Shot.
Short sword +6 melee, 1d6+3 piercing, 19–20/×2. Add +2 weapon damage against animals.
builds.tactics: Ilyra follows tracks at the edge of the trail. She uses one shot if she needs to move, and two from a clear position.

concepts.name: Bera Cinderbrace
concepts.motive: Get an overdue pottery wagon down from the ridge.
concepts.hook: She has the key to the toll gate but will only open it after checking the wagon seals.

concepts.name: Idrin Copperstep
concepts.motive: Find the animal digging through the ridge trail.
concepts.hook: He will guide the party to fresh tracks if they help mark a safe detour.

concepts.name: Janna Goldseed
concepts.motive: Recover the three parcels from a wagon that never reached the depot.
concepts.hook: Janna knows a shortcut to the stranded wagon and needs someone to watch the road.

concepts.name: Hurg Rimeshield
concepts.role: Night guard at a snowbound pass.
concepts.motive: Keep caravans off the avalanche road until the marker ropes are replaced.
concepts.hook: He offers safe passage by a lower route in exchange for a replacement lantern.

concepts.name: Ilyra Coldbriar
concepts.role: Guide and searcher for winter caravans.
concepts.motive: Find the missing guide before the next snowstorm.
concepts.hook: Ilyra has traced the guide to a shuttered stable that someone has been visiting after dark.
